title: MYCORIUM - Something simpler and easier to build but fun and cozy
author: angrylittledev
selftext:
[https://nerothearchangel.itch.io/mycorium](https://nerothearchangel.itch.io/mycorium)  
  
The basic code was made with Opus 4.6 and 4.7, almost all of it came out working without too many glitches, had to adjust the weight, and feeling but 90% worked out of the box. The issue was adjusting my artwork to it, the aligning frames, dealing with UI, and the nightmare of making it playable on mobile since it's originally Web based browser only game. I still don't like how it looks on mobile - desktop site, but it works great in mobile mode alone, but for the best experience go with the web. Art is too cute to be watched on a small screen.
